name: @customer-agent/api
description: 客服 Agent 正式 Application API 的 fail-closed 启动骨架

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @customer-agent/contracts build:runtime && pnpm build && node dist/main.js
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @customer-agent/contracts build:runtime && pnpm --filter @customer-agent/database build:runtime && CUSTOMER_AGENT_API_PG15_INTEGRATION=1 CUSTOMER_AGENT_API_G1A_RUNNER=1 vitest run tests/product-auth.integration.test.ts tests/content-import.integration.test.ts tests/content-worker.integration.test.ts tests/app.test.ts tests/search-postgres.integration.test.ts tests/event-postgres.integration.test.ts tests/g1a-synthetic.runner.test.ts
scripts.test:g1a:synthetic: pnpm --filter @customer-agent/contracts build:runtime && pnpm --filter @customer-agent/database build:runtime && CUSTOMER_AGENT_API_G1A_RUNNER=1 vitest run tests/g1a-synthetic.runner.test.ts
scripts.test:g1a:e0:synthetic: pnpm --filter @customer-agent/contracts build:runtime && pnpm --filter @customer-agent/database build:runtime && CUSTOMER_AGENT_API_G1A_E0_SYNTHETIC=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/g1a-e0-input-package.test.ts tests/g1a-e0-boundary.test.ts tests/g1a-e0-evaluate.test.ts tests/g1a-e0-synthetic.integration.test.ts tests/g1a-keyword-baseline.test.ts tests/g1a-comparison.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:g1a:e0:package: pnpm --filter @customer-agent/contracts build:runtime && pnpm --filter @customer-agent/database build:runtime && CUSTOMER_AGENT_API_G1A_E0_PACKAGE=1 vitest run tests/g1a-e0.runner.test.ts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @customer-agent/contracts build:runtime && pnpm --filter @customer-agent/database build:runtime && vitest run && pnpm test:package
scripts.assemble:g1a:owner: pnpm --filter @customer-agent/contracts build:runtime && CUSTOMER_AGENT_G1A_ASSEMBLE=1 vitest run tests/g1a-owner-assembly.runner.test.ts
scripts.test:g1a:comparison:package: pnpm --filter @customer-agent/contracts build:runtime && pnpm --filter @customer-agent/database build:runtime && CUSTOMER_AGENT_G1A_COMPARISON=1 vitest run tests/g1a-comparison.runner.test.ts
